concept.rationaleUz: Ushbu video reklama mazkur kulrang elektr choynakning oddiy va samarali dizaynini koʻrsatadi, oilalar uchun qulayligi va zamonaviyligini taʻkidlaydi.
concept.hookUz: Video choynakning toʻgʻri rakursda ustidan boshlanadi, uning silliq yuzasi va kulrang ranglari aniq koʻrinadi.
concept.ctaUz: Endi xarid qiling va qulaylikdan bahramand boʻling!

shots.descriptionUz: Kulrang elektr choynak toʻgʻri rakursda stolda turibdi, yuqoridan sekingina pastga qarab kamera harakati bilan yoritiladi.
shots.cameraUz: kerakli yorugʻlikda yuqoridan pastga suriladigan kamera harakati

shots.descriptionUz: Kamera choynakning tutqich qismiga yaqinlashadi, tutqichning ergonomik shakli va yonidagi texnik yorliq koʻrsatiladi.
Choynakning yon tomoni toʻliq koʻrsatiladi, yorliqdaki matn koʻzga tashlanmaydi, oxirida choynak barqaror holda stolda namoyish etiladi.
shots.cameraUz: sekin lateral tracking va barqaror hero kerama

result.promptEn: Show a single grey electric kettle placed on a clean white studio table as the only product in frame. The camera starts from an overhead top-down shot slowly moving down to reveal the kettle's smooth flat surface and overall rectangular silhouette. The grey color and minimal design of the kettle are clearly visible. Then the camera slowly pushes in toward the ergonomic handle on the kettle's left side, showing the handle shape and the technical label on the side, but the text on the label is blurry and unreadable. Finally, the camera moves laterally to show the kettle's full left side, maintaining focus on the kettle standing steadily on the table. Studio lighting is soft and even to reveal the true surface texture and color without glare. The background is clean and light to keep attention on the product. The sequence progresses smoothly with subtle transitions and calm pacing. The audio includes realistic subtle room tone and product placement sounds. The clip runs for 8 seconds in vertical 9:16 aspect ratio with modest camera moves to keep the kettle dominant and its details clear. Fidelity is crucial: the exact grey color, the kettle's rectangular shape, handle location, and the presence of an unreadable technical label on the side must remain unchanged. Avoid any text replacement, flashy effects, reflections that change color, or revealing unknown parts. The final hero shot centers the kettle, stable on the table, inviting viewers to appreciate its simple, functional design.
assumptionsUz: Yorliqdagi matn oʻqilmaydi, bu holatni videoda saqlab qolamiz.
Faqat bitta kulrang elektr choynak koʻrsatiladi, boshqa rang yoki variantlar yoʻq.
reviewNotesUz: Choynakning silliq, toʻgʻri shaklidagi kulrang rangini va tutqichning chap tomonda ekanligini taʻkidlang.
Yon tomondagi yorliqdagi matn oʻqib boʻlmasligi muhim va bu buzilmasligi kerak.
Videoda faqat choynak asosiy predmet sifatida namoyish qilinishi, ortiqcha effektlardan saqlanish kerak.
